verdict.rationale: Notion's docs reference user-created 'Custom Agents' that can be shared with connections and managed for status and credit limits through the Agent APIs. They also describe agents that 'keep work moving 24/7', and Skills pages that hold instructions for repeatable workflows. Together these indicate users can create and configure their own agents in the product, but the evidence only implies the build flow and never documents it directly. Missing for 10: first-party docs on the in-product agent builder (instructions, tools, triggers, data scope), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building a custom agent.
